issues.description: Missing 'use strict' directive which helps catch common coding mistakes and unsafe actions
issues.suggestion: Add 'use strict'; at the beginning of the file to enable strict mode and prevent silent errors

issues.description: Direct insertion of user input into DOM using innerHTML without sanitization creates XSS vulnerability
issues.suggestion: Use textContent for user input or implement proper HTML escaping. Better approach: Create elements programmatically using createElement and appendChild

issues.description: Function only checks if input is not empty but doesn't validate for whitespace-only input
issues.suggestion: Use if (!todoInput.value.trim()) return; to reject whitespace-only entries

issues.description: Using innerHTML += repeatedly causes entire list to be re-parsed and re-rendered on each addition
issues.suggestion: Use createElement, textContent, and appendChild for better performance and security

issues.description: Using inline onclick attributes in dynamically generated HTML violates Content Security Policy
issues.suggestion: Use event delegation by attaching a single event listener to the parent ul element

issues.description: Delete function uses removeChild with this.parentElement incorrectly, this context is unreliable in inline handlers
issues.suggestion: Implement proper event delegation and use element.remove() or correctly identify the list item to remove

issues.description: No try-catch blocks for localStorage operations which can fail due to quota exceeded or privacy settings
issues.suggestion: Wrap localStorage operations in try-catch blocks with appropriate error handling

issues.description: saveTodos and loadTodos functions are defined but never called, making persistence feature non-functional
issues.suggestion: Call loadTodos() on page load and saveTodos() after each todo operation (add, toggle, delete)

issues.description: All functions are declared in global scope which can lead to naming conflicts
issues.suggestion: Wrap the code in an IIFE or use ES6 modules to avoid polluting the global namespace

codeQuality.summary: Code has critical security vulnerabilities (XSS) and architectural issues. Direct innerHTML manipulation without sanitization is a severe risk. DOM manipulation is inefficient, and error handling is missing for localStorage operations. Persistence feature is incomplete as save/load functions are never called. Event handling uses inline handlers which violates CSP. Requires immediate security fixes before production deployment.

untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test saving to localStorage, loading from localStorage, handling localStorage errors and quota exceeded

untestedPaths.reasoning: Security testing for malicious input like script tags, HTML injection attempts

untestedPaths.reasoning: localStorage may not be available in private browsing or due to browser settings

testCoverage.summary: No test files exist for script.js. All core functions (addTodo, toggleTodo, deleteTodo, saveTodos, loadTodos) are completely untested. Critical security vulnerabilities and edge cases have no test coverage. Recommend implementing Jest or Vitest with minimum 80% coverage target before merging.

suggestions.description: Extract todo element creation into separate function to improve code organization and reusability
suggestions.benefits: Separates todo creation logic from DOM manipulation, single responsibility per function, easier to test individual components, improves readability, enables reuse of creation logic

suggestions.description: Replace inline event handlers with event delegation pattern for better performance and memory management
suggestions.benefits: Better memory management (one listener vs many), improved performance with many todos, cleaner code without inline handlers, easier to add new interactive elements, follows modern event delegation pattern

suggestions.description: Use template literals instead of string concatenation for improved readability
suggestions.benefits: More readable and modern syntax, easier to maintain complex strings, consistent with ES6+ best practices, better IDE support

suggestions.description: Wrap code in IIFE or use ES6 modules to avoid global namespace pollution
suggestions.benefits: Prevents naming conflicts, encapsulates implementation details, cleaner global namespace, better for code organization in larger projects

suggestions.description: Extract validation logic into dedicated function for better separation of concerns
suggestions.benefits: Separates validation logic, easier to extend with more validation rules, can replace alert with better UI feedback, improves testability

refactorings.summary: Major refactoring opportunities include extracting todo creation logic into smaller functions, implementing event delegation pattern, and wrapping code to avoid global scope pollution. These changes would significantly improve maintainability, testability, and performance while following modern JavaScript best practices.

suggestions.description: Replace hard-coded colors with CSS custom properties for easier theming and maintenance
suggestions.benefits: Easier theming and customization, single source of truth for colors, better maintainability, enables dark mode implementation

refactorings.summary: CSS would benefit from using CSS custom properties for better maintainability and theming support.

recommendations.description: Fix XSS vulnerability in script.js by replacing innerHTML manipulation with safe DOM methods (createElement, textContent, appendChild). This is a severe security risk that must be addressed before merging.

Implement test suite with Jest or Vitest. No tests currently exist for any functionality. At minimum, add tests for core functions (addTodo, toggleTodo, deleteTodo, saveTodos, loadTodos) before merging to production.
Fix deleteTodo function which has incorrect DOM manipulation logic. The current implementation with this.parentElement in inline handlers will not work reliably.
Complete localStorage implementation by calling loadTodos() on page load and saveTodos() after each operation. Currently defined but never invoked, making persistence non-functional.
Implement event delegation pattern to replace inline event handlers. This improves performance, memory usage, and CSP compliance.
Add try-catch blocks around localStorage operations to handle quota exceeded errors and privacy settings that block storage.
Improve input validation to reject whitespace-only entries using trim() method.
Refactor addTodo function by extracting todo element creation into separate functions. This improves testability and follows single responsibility principle.
Add 'use strict' directive and wrap code in IIFE or convert to ES6 modules to avoid global scope pollution.
Add ARIA labels to form inputs and buttons, use semantic HTML5 elements (header, main, section) for better accessibility.
Add defer attribute to script tag for better page load performance.
Implement CSS custom properties (CSS variables) for colors and common values to enable easier theming.
